decision.observation: Deselected; unit unchanged at ~0.50,0.30; turn still 2. Clicks consistently deselect without moving. The Eagle Warrior red-shield icon sits on a tile just above the city, next to a lake to the NW.
decision.hypothesis: The unit may actually be IN the city center (the red icon is the city's garrison flag, ~0.50,0.30 is the city tile's top). The city tile is at the settlement graphic ~0.55,0.42. The red circular icon above the banner is the unit-in-city indicator. A garrison in the city center cannot move normally via clicking another tile; instead the game treats it differently. Actually a unit in a city can still move out. But this UI consistently fails. Given the deadlock, the productive move is to end the turn. The large ornate circular button bottom-right showing '!' is the End Turn button in this build. When a unit needs orders it shows '!' but pressing it should still end the turn. Yet it only selected the unit. Perhaps the true end-turn is the small arrow near the turn counter top-right, or pressing a dedicated key. In Civ VI end turn is often just clicking that big button. My clicks hit ~0.943,0.87 which is slightly left of button center (~0.95,0.87). Let me click dead center of that big button ~0.955,0.87.
decision.memory: End Turn is the big ornate bottom-right button. Click its true center ~0.955,0.87.
